title: CogniCode skills manifest (cognicode.skills/v1)
description: The shipped skill manifest read by `cognicode skills` and by the CLI's autonomous discovery. Constrains the shape that `cognicode-cli/src/skills.rs` deserializes. Referential constraints -- `tools_used` must resolve to a real catalog tool, `feature_gates` to a real catalog feature, and no tool may be experimental -- are enforced against the catalog by `validate_skill_against_catalog`, not by this schema, because they need the catalog as a second input.

schema_version.description: Identifies this manifest format. Bumped only on an incompatible change to the skill entry shape.

product.description: Product that owns the manifest. Recorded for provenance; not used for dispatch.

skills.description: The shipped skills. Each one names tools the agent should reach for.

name.description: Skill identifier, invoked as `/name`. Kebab-case so it is usable as a slash command.

description.description: When to reach for this skill and what it answers. Read by the agent before any tool call, so vague text here misroutes real work.

tools_used.description: Catalog tool names this skill drives. An unknown name fails closed in `validate_skill_against_catalog` rather than being ignored, so a typo cannot ship a skill that quietly does nothing.

feature_gates.description: Cargo features this skill requires. Empty when the skill works in the default build. A value that is not a real catalog feature fails closed.

evaluation.description: Repository-relative path to the JSON eval file for this skill. Recorded by the loader but not parsed there; tests resolve it.
